integrity: The original 1994 Sprott article and the 2001 statistical Sprott-flow article were inspected in full. The exact generator identities, equilibrium coordinates, conditional-law premises, and variance-gap coefficients were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. Equality cases were reconstructed from invariant-support tangency and bounded completeness. Noncoverage claims are limited to material actually read.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures, not arbitrary unbounded trajectories.
The first two y-moments alone do not distinguish a nonequilibrium invariant measure from a suitable equilibrium mixture.
The complete Panchev 2004 analytical article was not securely available for full-text comparison.
The later fractional-order Sprott K article was used only to confirm the canonical equations and research context, not for a whole-document noncoverage claim.
A differently phrased or unindexed stationary-moment result could remain unlocated.
title: Exact stationary equilibrium-segment law and variance defects in Sprott K
